shared_elements: schematic human figure with raised/upraised arms
small stick-like anthropomorph with splayed legs
groups of scattered figures across an open rock surface
long straight lines / linear bands crossing the field

justification: Both surfaces show highly schematic anthropomorphs with thick, simplified limbs, several with arms raised and legs splayed, scattered irregularly across an open rock face alongside straight linear elements and ladder/comb-like geometric signs, which is a fairly specific shared repertoire. The main differences in content are A's concentric circles/ring motifs and curved boat-like line, which have no counterpart in B, while B's panel is dominated by one large figure among long ruled lines with no circular motifs.
